name: Apert症候群

summary.text: A frequent form of acrocephalosyndactyly, a group of inherited congenital malformation disorders, characterized by craniosynostosis, midface hypoplasia, and finger and toe anomalies and/or syndactyly.

symptoms.text: finger and toe anomalies and/or syndactyly
